script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. Venus, your ruling planet, is squaring Pluto in your fourth House of Home and Roots, and that same Pluto is touching your tenth House of Career. This is heavy, earthy tension, and it asks you to release what feels secure but is no longer built to last. In love, your seventh House of Partnership is being scrutinized by this Pluto square, so a hidden loyalty issue or deep trust test may surface with someone you thought was solid. With money and career, your tenth House of Career is caught in the fallout, and your second House of Finances may tighten if you cling to pride. Avoid digging in your heels over pride tonight, but an unexpected gift arrives through a trusted friend's honest warning. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
